subject: Provider-neutral FA3 Objective Coordination Layer above existing work-management and orchestration authorities
decisions: Do not repurpose FA3 Developer Agent Coordination as the system-wide coordinator.
Do not create a new execution/orchestration authority.
Represent high-level goals as provider-neutral Objectives containing references to existing tasks/workflows/operations.
Project coordination inside Work Management instead of creating a duplicate top-level task-management application.
Reuse external systems only as architectural pattern sources; introduce no Temporal/Dagster/Prefect/Kestra/Backstage/OpenTelemetry runtime dependency in this materialization.
Keep future dedicated Task Manager and Logistics bindings optional until separately materialized and admitted.
